Species & Ancestry.name: Species & Ancestry
Species & Ancestry.description: Choose one ancestry and describe your individual adult appearance. Each grants the listed modest +1 skill and its actual anatomy. Culture, occupation, morality and magical affinity remain individual.

Beastfolk Form.name: Beastfolk Form
Beastfolk Form.description: Optional — for Beastfolk or a mixed-ancestry character with beastfolk heritage. Choose one mostly human form or skip and describe your own. Rare more animal-like bodies require explicit direction.

Fae Form.name: Fae Form
Fae Form.description: Optional — for Fae or a mixed-ancestry character with fae heritage. Choose one starting body plan or skip and describe a coherent individual blend. These are appearance examples, not rigid subraces.

Fae Stature.name: Fae Stature
Fae Stature.description: Optional — select a fae adult height or skip. Short fae keep adult faces and proportions. Height grants no power or age change.

Origin & Upbringing.name: Origin & Upbringing
Origin & Upbringing.description: Choose one formative background: where your life began or what work surrounded you. +1 relevant utility skill, but no automatic personal connections, property, legal status or quest completion.

Primary Aptitude.name: Primary Aptitude
Primary Aptitude.description: Choose your strongest aptitude: +5, normally 15 from base 10. Force covers physical power, resilience, and guarded fighting; Finesse covers coordination, precision, and timing. Logic, Passion, Empathy, and Intuition support the listed magical disciplines. This is capability, not a personality or class. The choice also supplies common foundational skills at level 0.

Secondary Aptitude.name: Secondary Aptitude
Secondary Aptitude.description: Choose a different supporting aptitude: +3, normally 13. A spellblade can pair a physical and magical aptitude; a dedicated caster can pair two magical aptitudes. Other attributes remain 10. A matching primary is excluded. No attribute is required for the basic Health, Mana or Stamina pool.

Natural Magical Affinity.name: Natural Magical Affinity
Natural Magical Affinity.description: Choose 1–3 natural affinities: disciplines you find easier to learn. Affinities are separate from Starting Magical Study and grant no skills or spells by themselves. Other magic can be learned through practice, study or mentorship. Space and Time are not starting choices.

Starting Magical Study.name: Starting Magical Study
Starting Magical Study.description: Choose up to two disciplines you have studied. Each starts at skill level 3 with two introductory techniques. Studies may differ from your affinities. Choose none for an untrained or martial background. Space and Time are unavailable at creation; advanced Space study requires Gravity preparation. Shared Spellcraft knowledge does not mean you can cast every discipline.

Practical Training.name: Practical Training
Practical Training.description: Choose one or two distinct practiced approaches. Force, Finesse, and Guarded Training each grant the matching combat skill at level 3; Scholarly Practice grants spellcraft 2 and investigation 1. Each option represents separate prior practice. Weapon and unarmed methods follow actual training and equipment, not one forced attribute for every sword. These choices grant no attribute points or automatic advanced abilities.

Profession & Useful Skills.name: Profession & Useful Skills
Profession & Useful Skills.description: Choose one useful prior profession or practical training. Grants +2 in an existing utility skill. This is experience, not an automatically accepted job or official license.

Starting Equipment.name: Starting Equipment
Starting Equipment.description: Choose one basic casting, martial or practical kit, or Hand-Casting Practice for no extra item. It is independent of your training style. Ordinary tools, clothing and remembered techniques stay distinct; a kit grants only its listed items once.

Temperament.name: Temperament
Temperament.description: Optional — choose up to two tendencies, or skip. These are narrative preferences with no skill bonus or penalty; your actual words and decisions remain yours.

First Impression.name: First Impression
First Impression.description: Optional — skip this category if you prefer: how a stranger might initially read your visible presentation. Purely narrative. Actual circumstances and individual NPC judgment always matter.

Personal Motivation.name: Personal Motivation
Personal Motivation.description: Optional — skip this category if you prefer: what the character may be seeking. This creates motivation, not a mandatory quest, background tragedy, debt, relationship, status, or obligation.

Personal Complication.name: Personal Complication
Personal Complication.description: Optional — skip this category if you prefer: one realistic personal difficulty for stories and relationships. Narrative only: no mandatory penalty, trauma, or automatic player action.

Appearance Builder.name: Appearance Builder
Appearance Builder.description: Optional — choose up to one detail in each group, or skip any or all and write your own appearance. Hair, eyes, skin, build and outfit are visual choices. Portrait style, framing, camera and backdrop have their own optional sections below. Written appearance takes precedence. Styling does not grant equipment or membership.

subcategories.name: Hair Color — choose up to one
Hair Style — choose up to one
Eye Color — choose up to one
Skin Tone — choose up to one

Portrait Style.name: Portrait Style
Portrait Style.description: Optional — skip for the default crisp, colorful 2D fantasy-anime style. All choices remain hand-drawn anime; none changes abilities or equipment.

Portrait Framing.name: Portrait Framing
Portrait Framing.description: Optional — waist-up or hip-up. Skip for a fitting hip-up or waist-up composition, full head in frame, without a fixed headroom percentage.

Portrait Camera.name: Portrait Camera
Portrait Camera.description: Optional — choose a viewpoint, or leave it to the illustration. The default is a readable natural eye-level or three-quarter view.

Portrait Background.name: Portrait Background
Portrait Background.description: Optional — choose a picture backdrop or skip for a fitting setting from your opening. A background styles the portrait and does not move your character.
